steps.label: Asset Transfer
steps.caption: All properties and liabilities transfer to the amalgamated company.

steps.label: Shareholder Continuity
steps.caption: Three fourths of shareholders in value become continuing owners.

steps.label: Capital Gains Exemption
steps.caption: Asset transfers and share exchanges enjoy full statutory exemption.

steps.label: Loss Carry Forward
steps.caption: Amalgamated entity inherits accumulated business losses and allowances.

steps.label: Undertaking Definition
steps.caption: Corporate unit transfers as an autonomous viable going concern.

steps.label: Book Value Transfer
steps.caption: Assets and liabilities transfer at historic book values without markup.

steps.label: Proportionate Allotment
steps.caption: Resulting entity issues shares directly to parent shareholders.

steps.label: Apportioned Tax Shield
steps.caption: Accumulated losses are divided proportionately between companies.

steps.label: Lump Sum Transfer
steps.caption: Business undertaking transfers for single unassigned consideration.

steps.label: Net Worth Calculation
steps.caption: Depreciable assets at written down value form cost of acquisition.

steps.label: Fair Value Comparison
steps.caption: Consideration is benchmarked against market value of assets sold.

steps.label: Capital Gain Assessment
steps.caption: Gain is computed without indexation benefit under special code.

steps.label: Wholly Owned Exemption
steps.caption: Asset transfer between parent and subsidiary is exempt from tax.

steps.label: Eight Year Limitation
steps.caption: Holding company must maintain full ownership for eight full years.

steps.label: Share Dilution Event
steps.caption: Reduction of equity holding triggers statutory clawback of relief.

steps.label: Retroactive Charge
steps.caption: Originally exempt gain becomes taxable income in year of dilution.

steps.label: Merger Qualification
steps.caption: System verifies statutory asset and shareholder continuity tests.

steps.label: Loss Schedule Audit
steps.caption: Engine projects cash tax savings from absorbed industrial losses.

steps.label: Slump Sale Valuation
steps.caption: Module calculates net worth and fair market value capital gains.

steps.label: Clawback Watchdog
steps.caption: Platform monitors equity retention to prevent statutory tax clawback.
